subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported scope be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract covering Telegram and Discord too?
rationale: The issue asks for new channel config and pause/resume state that changes visible message delivery behavior, so code cannot safely choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
options.body: Add the handoff behavior only to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with room to generalize after live proof and user feedback.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a common handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting a larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: Defer product feature
options.body: Keep current prompt/manual-pause workarounds and defer handoff automation until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship exists.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
recommendation.body: Add the handoff behavior only to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with room to generalize after live proof and user feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a channel config and product/API direction choice, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from recent broad channel/plugin config history.
